title: KYC Review Desk Card — Documents Received in the Month Before a Personal Sender Account Limit Review
content:
Fresh documents, for a limit review request on a Personal Sender Account, are the verification documents received on the account in the month before the request date, a document received on the same calendar day of the previous month or before it no longer counting. When 3 or more were received, 2 business days are added to the counted decision window of the request; when at least 1 but fewer than 3 were received, 1 business day is added to the counted decision window; when none were received, nothing is added for fresh documents.

## Input — judgement — output

- **Input:** the verification documents logged as received on the account, by the date Paloma received each one.
- **Judgement:** how many were received after the same calendar day of the previous month, up to the request date.
- **Output:**

| Documents received in that month | Business days added |
|---|---|
| none | 0 |
| 1 | 1 |
| 2 | 1 |
| 3 or more | 2 |

## Points of judgement

- Every received document counts, whatever its kind and whatever the outcome of its review, accepted, rejected or still pending review.
- The count is by document received, not by review: a document received once counts once.
- Hypothetical dates: for a request lodged on 20 May, documents received on 21 April through 20 May count; a document received on 20 April, or before it, does not.
